findings.detail: span "text occluded by an over" is 100% covered by an opaque element (div.dynamic-form-demo__toolbar)
findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.detail: ~86 chars/line (aim for <80)
findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.detail: raster background at opacity 0
findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.detail: ~86 chars/line (aim for <80)
findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.detail: raster background at opacity 0
findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.detail: ~86 chars/line (aim for <80)
findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.detail: raster background at opacity 0
findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.detail: span "✦ ai color palette" is 100% covered by an opaque element (div.el-upload-dragger)
findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Bounce or elastic easing
findings.description: Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.

findings.detail: transition: height, padding-top, padding-bottom
findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.detail: raster background at opacity 0
findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Bounce or elastic easing
findings.description: Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.

findings.name: Layout property animation

findings.detail: ~86 chars/line (aim for <80)
findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.detail: raster background at opacity 0
findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.detail: div.el-form-item__label "任务封面（单张）" is 100% covered by overlapping text (li.el-select-dropdown__item.is-selected.is-hovering)
findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Bounce or elastic easing
findings.description: Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.

findings.detail: transition: height, padding-top, padding-bottom
findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

banners:

layout property animation: transition: height, padding-top, padding-bottom

findings.detail: raster background at opacity 0
findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.detail: span "✦ ai color palette" is 100% covered by an opaque element (div.el-upload-dragger)
findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Bounce or elastic easing
findings.description: Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.

findings.detail: transition: height, padding-top, padding-bottom
findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.detail: ~86 chars/line (aim for <80)
findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.detail: raster background at opacity 0
findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

attribution.textSnippet: feedback 只负责呈现宿主传入的状态。retry 只触发宿主的恢复流程，网络请求仍由宿主按 .then().catch().finally() 编排；状态为 loading 时重试按钮会禁用，避免重复发起请求。错误、加载和空结果不需要再在表单底部重复一份文案。

findings.detail: ~86 chars/line (aim for <80)
findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.name: Line length too long

findings.detail: raster background at opacity 0
findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.detail: span "数字输入" is 100% covered by overlapping text (span.lx-btn__label)
findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Bounce or elastic easing
findings.description: Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.

findings.detail: transition: height, padding-top, padding-bottom
findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Bounce or elastic easing
findings.description: Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.

findings.detail: transition: height, padding-top, padding-bottom
findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. findings.detail: span.lang "vue" is 50% covered by overlapping text (p)
findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Bounce or elastic easing
findings.description: Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.

findings.name: Layout property animation

findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.detail: span.lang "vue" is 50% covered by overlapping text (p)
findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Bounce or elastic easing
findings.description: Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.

findings.detail: transition: height, padding-top, padding-bottom
findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.detail: raster background at opacity 0
findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.detail: span.lang "vue" is 50% covered by overlapping text (p)
findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Bounce or elastic easing
findings.description: Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.

findings.detail: transition: height, padding-top, padding-bottom
findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.
